Can you believe that he brought that weapon into our house? Not a hunting rifle, but a pistol! A weapon of war!|Dren's father|<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Dren Melne]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He and his [[Dren Melne's mother|wife]] were the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of another [[Dren Melne's brother|son]] after him.

==Biography==

Dren Melne's family held a great deal of contempt to Melne's decision to leave [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to become a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to the point of his father referencing how he came back home years later in a black [[Flight suit]] and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistol]] instead of a [[Hunting rifle/Legends|Hunting rifle]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />

At [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] Dren Melne betrayed [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]], who was his lover, when he attempted to collaborate with the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] [[Challep]], to steal [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 fighters]] for their technology and was killed by his own contractors. When Essara Till relayed this to the family they were hostile to her inquiries and blamed [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]{{'s}} off-world dealings as part of his influence to become a mercenary. He would soon watch with pride when his younger son chased Till down the streets of Naboo. Essara Till believed that Melne's family influenced his decision to betray Naboo.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
